name: BE SEMICON.INDSINH.EO-,01
summary: BE SEMICON.INDSINH.EO-,01 refers to BE Semiconductor Industries N.V. (Besi), a leading manufacturer of assembly equipment for the semiconductor industry. Besi develops, manufactures, markets and services advanced technology for the back-end semiconductor equipment market. The company is headquartered in Duiven, the Netherlands.
